public_source_headers.name: Trees.complete_node
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem complete_node (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    Complete (.node a l r) ↔ l.height = r.height ∧ Complete l ∧ Complete r

public_source_headers.name: Trees.complete_map
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem complete_map (label : α → β) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    Complete (t.map label) ↔ Complete t

public_source_headers.name: Trees.complete_iff_minHeight_eq_height
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem complete_iff_minHeight_eq_height (t : BinaryTree α) :
    Complete t ↔ minHeight t = t.height

public_source_headers.name: Trees.numLeaves_eq_pow_height
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem numLeaves_eq_pow_height (t : BinaryTree α) :
    Complete t → t.numLeaves = 2 ^ t.height

public_source_headers.name: Trees.complete_almostComplete
public_source_headers.source_header:

    AlmostComplete t

theorem almostComplete_children (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold
public_source_headers.source_header: def fold (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) : BinaryTree α → β

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold_nil
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem fold_nil (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) :
    fold empty combine .nil = empty

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold_node
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem fold_node (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    fold empty combine (.node a l r) =
      combine (fold empty combine l) a (fold empty combine r)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold_map
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem fold_map (empty : β) (combine : β → γ → β → β)
    (label : α → γ) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    fold empty combine (t.map label) =
      fold empty (fun l a r => combine l (label a) r) t

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold_fusion
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem fold_fusion (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (empty' : γ) (combine' : γ → α → γ → γ) (observe : β → γ)
    (h_empty : observe empty = empty')
    (h_node : ∀ l a r, observe (combine l a r) =
      combine' (observe l) a (observe r)) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    observe (fold empty combine t) = fold empty' combine' t

public_source_headers.name: Trees.fold_height
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem fold_height (t : BinaryTree α) :
    fold (0 : Nat) (fun l (_ : α) r => max l r + 1) t = t.height

public_source_headers.name: Trees.height_map
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem height_map (label : α → β) (t : BinaryTree α) :
    (t.map label).height = t.height

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.read_nil
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem read_nil (empty : β) :
    read empty (.nil : BinaryTree (α × β)) = empty

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.read_node
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem read_node (empty : β) (a : α) (b : β)
    (l r : BinaryTree (α × β)) : read empty (.node (a, b) l r) = b

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.smartNode
Trees.Cached.read_smartNode
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem read_smartNode (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    read empty (smartNode empty combine l a r) =
      combine (read empty l) a (read empty r)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.erase_smartNode
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem erase_smartNode (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    erase (smartNode empty combine l a r) = .node a (erase l) (erase r)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.Valid
public_source_headers.source_header:
def Valid (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) :
    BinaryTree (α × β) → Prop

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.valid_nil
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem valid_nil (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β) :
    Valid empty combine .nil

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.valid_node
public_source_headers.source_header:
@[simp] theorem valid_node (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (a : α) (b : β) (l r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    Valid empty combine (.node (a, b) l r) ↔
      Valid empty combine l ∧ Valid empty combine r ∧
        b = combine (read empty l) a (read empty r)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.smartNode_valid_iff
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem smartNode_valid_iff (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (l : BinaryTree (α × β)) (a : α) (r : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    Valid empty combine (smartNode empty combine l a r) ↔
      Valid empty combine l ∧ Valid empty combine r

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.read_eq_fold
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem read_eq_fold (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (t : BinaryTree (α × β)) (ht : Valid empty combine t) :
    read empty t = Trees.fold empty combine (erase t)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.height_erase
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem height_erase (t : BinaryTree (α × β)) :
    (erase t).height = t.height

public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem annotate_valid (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.erase_annotate
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem erase_annotate (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)

public_source_headers.name: Trees.Cached.read_annotate

theorem read_annotate (empty : β) (combine : β → α → β → β)
    (t : BinaryTree α) :
    read empty (annotate empty combine t) = Trees.fold empty combine t

public_source_headers.name: Trees.subtree_node_iff
public_source_headers.source_header:
theorem subtree_node_iff (s : BinaryTree α) (a : α) (l r : BinaryTree α) :
    Subtree s (.node a l r) ↔
      s = .node a l r ∨ Subtree s l ∨ Subtree s r

public_source_headers.name: Trees.mem_subtrees_iff

@[simp] theorem mem_subtrees_iff {s t : BinaryTree α} :
    s ∈ subtrees t ↔ Subtree s t
